action: Accept Maria Santos's invitation to speak at the task force meeting. Prepare structured testimony specifically addressing who is being left out of existing programs: returning workers without current credentials, gig workers with inconsistent income history who don't qualify for traditional assistance, people with transportation barriers who can't reach program sites, individuals who won't self-identify as unemployed due to stigma, and those displaced by automation (specifically rideshare and taxi workers) who are too old or too resource-depleted to retrain without bridge support. Ground all testimony in anonymized intake data from Community Connection Nights, not anecdote alone. Frame the excluded populations not as failures of individual will but as gaps in program design — this matters for policy, and it matters for how Maria can present it to colleagues who will be resistant.
